before_times: hands, feet or both, and which services
what's on the nails now: nothing, gel, dip or acrylic, and from this salon or another (a removal adds time and price)
nail art: none, a little, or a custom design (design photos for a custom set)
which nail tech, or the first one free
for a bridal party or a nail party: how many people, and the date
after_time: anything the nail tech should know
for a visit away from the salon: the address, parking, and a table near a plug with good light
secure_page_only: 18 or older, or a parent or guardian books
diabetes, or poor feeling or blood flow in the feet
an infection, cut or sore on the hands or feet
ever reacted to gel or acrylic
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, and they stay for the visit

stop.words: an allergic reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, or hard to breathe
nail glue, acetone or another product in the eye
stop.say: Rinse the eye with clean water for 15 minutes, and call 911.

go_on.words: a finger or toe that's red, swollen, hot or oozing, or a cut or sore on the hands or feet
go_on.what: no nail work on that area: the customer keeps the other service or moves it until it heals; a wound that looks infected should be seen by a doctor first; a skipped service isn't charged

go_on.words: diabetes, or poor feeling in the feet (answered on the secure page only)
go_on.what: the booking goes on, with care notes for the nail tech: no cutting cuticles or calluses, gentle filing, warm water, a close look at the feet

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

first_steps_and_forms.steps: none: nail work needs no first visit
first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: say if gel, dip or acrylic is on now; for a pedicure, skip shaving the legs the day before; bring design photos for nail art; for a visit away from the salon, a table near a plug and good light

staff.skills: manicure, pedicure, gel, dip, acrylic, nail art, custom art, lashes and brows; only nail techs who do custom art are offered for it
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each nail tech's license per state; lash and brow work where the state licenses it
staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed nail tech, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs every custom art quote and a past reaction to gel or acrylic
staff.stand_in: any nail tech licensed for the service, who gets the care notes and the nail history; same time, chair and price

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, and they stay for the visit
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the salon: the check-in code at the front desk; at a home or event: the code from whoever will be there (the bride or the host when a mobile is given for them)
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the nail tech; the product, shape and colors go in the nail tech's notes for next time
visit.changes_at_visit: extra work (nail art, a removal, a repair) is priced and OK'd before it's done; art by design is priced at the table
visit.before_work: the nail tech checks the hands, feet and the product on now, and reads the care notes, before starting; if the product isn't what was said (acrylic, not gel), the right removal's list price is told first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: nail work (nail technology, manicuring or cosmetology, by the state's own name) is licensed where the state's rules require it
license.who: both: the salon holds a salon (shop) license, and each nail tech holds their own; a mobile business holds a mobile license where the state issues one
license.ask: the salon's license number; each nail tech's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: diabetes, infection, sore, reaction and allergy answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record
